notes: Qty 60 as listed; the section headers add to 61 because 'Interrupts (11)' lists ten cards. Starting (8): the Objective (posted 'COTVG'), Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Prepared Defenses, Oppressive Enforcement, Mobilization Points and No Escape. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

'Take 2' of the author's post 11798 (Jabba and his Court flies off to Space): the post lists the changes (out Docking Bay 94, Darth Vader With Lightsaber, Admiral Ozzel, Lieutenant Endicott, Elis Helrot; in Imperial Arrest Order, Executor, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, IG-88 With Riot Gun, Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, Commander Merrejk), so it is a separate list.

Posted 'COTVG' dested Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die; 'DVDLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Dr. E' Dr. Evazan; 'Mighty Jabba (The JPOTSD one.)' Mighty Jabba; 'Chimera' Chimaera; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'IG in IG-2000' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'ZIMH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Twi'lek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Vader's Stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Mara's Stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.

Sniper is the A New Hope Interrupt and Monnok the Jabba's Palace Interrupt (the Reflections II combos Sniper & Dark Strike and Evader & Monnok came out later); Oppressive Enforcement is the Special Edition Effect. Sullust, Kiffex, Kashyyyk, Endor and Tatooine: Cantina as posted (Dark versions).
